Lemma
[Boundary tori are incompressible] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0203, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0204 1. ch31:31.25\group Hyperbolic 3-manifolds

Every torus slice in a finite-volume hyperbolic cusp is incompressible in the ambient hyperbolic 3-manifold.
